hero_title: Explore Kyrgyzstan on Prepared Off-Road Vehicles
hero_subtitle: Rent legendary Toyota TLC 100, Lexus LX 470, and Lexus GX 470 with rooftop tents and full camping gear.
cars_subtitle: Reliable Japanese 4.7L V8 4x4s equipped with rooftop tents and full off-grid gear.
eq_subtitle: Every vehicle is fully equipped with camping gear for off-grid mountain adventures.
eq_extra_desc: If more than 2 travelers are joining, an additional standard ground tent is included for free!
price_subtitle: Transparent pricing without hidden fees. Minimum rental period is 5 days.
price_region_note: Pick-up / Return in other regions is discussed individually.
terms_subtitle: Please read the vehicle operation rules and deposit return policy.
terms_bilingual_note: The Russian text is informational; the English agreement prevails.
terms_ala_too: Ala-Too Policy: Rental is available for groups with a minimum of 3 passengers.
terms_g1: The vehicle may not be transferred to a third party.
terms_g2: The vehicle must be returned clean.
terms_g3: The client is responsible to safely operate the vehicle:
terms_g3a: The client must ensure that the vehicle remains in roadworthy condition.
terms_g3b: Oil and Coolant must be checked regularly.
terms_g3c: Tires and tire pressure should be observed regularly.
terms_g3d: “Kyrgyz4x4rentals” must be notified immediately if the vehicle has reached its service interval.
terms_g3e: Small repairs (up to 100 USD) of a non-critical nature may be performed by the client, but will not be reimbursed without prior agreement by “Kyrgyz4x4rentals”.
terms_g3f: Major repairs (over 100 USD) may only be performed with “Kyrgyz4x4rentals’” approval.
terms_g4: All road fines are the responsibility of the driver.
terms_g5: Damage resulting from negligence (i.e. use of incorrect fuel, ignoring gauges/warning lights, unjustified off roading etc.) is not covered by insurance and will be charged to the driver/client.
terms_g6: Ignoring the instructions of any “Kyrgyz4x4rentals” staff or representative will result in the forfeit of the security deposit.
terms_g7: The client must keep the vehicle locked when not present with the vehicle.
terms_g8: Breakdowns and problems as a result of the client’s negligence will be charged in full to the client, including any recovery fees incurred by “Kyrgyz4x4rentals”.
terms_g9: The client is responsible to follow all laws and regulations of the country in which they are operating the vehicle. Any legal fees incurred by “Kyrgyz4x4rentals” as a result of the client’s actions will be charged to the client.
terms_g10: Pick-up / Return regions: Pick-up and return of the vehicle in regions other than Bishkek is discussed individually with the client upon contact.
terms_b1: If the client wants to return the car during the trip for his own reason, the company does not return the money for the remaining days, as the order of other orders will be violated.
terms_b2: Breakdowns are an unfortunate part of life in Central Asia. In the event that your vehicle breaks down, please inform “Kyrgyz4x4rentals” immediately.
terms_b3: Inside Kyrgyzstan “Kyrgyz4x4rentals” or its representative will repair the vehicle or supply an alternative. If no alternative options suitable to the client can be arranged, then a refund of the unused days will be made.
terms_b4: “Kyrgyz4x4rentals” is not obligated to refund lost time due to a breakdown and will do so only at its discretion.
terms_i2: Deposit return condition: If no traffic violations, fines, or body/interior damage are found upon return, the deposit is returned to the client in full (800€) upon completion of the trip! If violations, scratches, or fines are found, the corresponding amount is deducted from the deposit.
terms_i3: “Kyrgyz4x4rentals” will not refund lost time due to an accident.
terms_c3: Scratches to bumpers or light damage: Typically 200 - 300 €
forbidden_desc: Warning! For safety reasons, driving on the following mountain passes and roads is strictly forbidden. Ignoring these restrictions may result in full loss of the security deposit!
